author: Sega Jenesis
title: Seeking digital artists for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content:
🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀

I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them!

I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters.

Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway!

Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚

If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰

author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two pieces of character art
content:
I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening?

Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info privately later.

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character art artist for upcoming book
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please!
